rules.why: If a workflow breaks unnoticed, validation, secret isolation, or attention routing can be bypassed.
If the router breaks unnoticed, every pull request can receive the wrong floor, comment, or notification.
If the host rules or rubric break unnoticed, repository changes can be systematically misclassified.
If the dashboard shell, shared model, or sample data breaks unnoticed, multiple views can explain the routing model incorrectly.
If dashboard build configuration breaks unnoticed, the reference application can stop linting, testing, or building.
If workspace dependency configuration breaks unnoticed, package and dashboard validation can fail together.
If operating or installation guidance is wrong, adopters can weaken the trust boundary or misconfigure notifications.
If repository process instructions break unnoticed, contributors or automation can follow the wrong review procedure.
